title: Sawai language
description: Austronesian language spoken in North Maluku, Indonesia
extract: The Sawai language is a South Halmahera language of the Austronesian language family spoken in the Weda, Weda Selatan and Gane Timor districts of southern Halmahera, in North Maluku Province of Indonesia. There are approximately 12,000 speakers.
